title: 24 forms · one small step at a time
provenance: Manually reviewed source-video microsteps. Actual parent video and MediaPipe observations are preserved; no interpolated or fabricated poses.

steps.title: Prepare to step
steps.cue: Stand upright and begin lifting the stepping foot.
steps.chineseCue: 站稳，开始提起要迈出的脚。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 2.0s the feet begin to separate; arms stay lowered.

steps.title: Lift the stepping foot
steps.cue: Bring the foot clear of the ground before moving it sideways.
steps.chineseCue: 将迈步脚提离地面，准备向侧面打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 3.0s the stepping knee is raised and the foot is off the ground.

steps.title: Place the foot to the side
steps.cue: Set the lifted foot down to make a wider stance.
steps.chineseCue: 将提起的脚落向侧面，站距打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: The foot travels outward at 4.0s and is planted by 5.0s.

steps.title: Settle the open stance
steps.cue: Let both legs share the stance as the hands begin to float forward.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚站稳，双手开始向前抬起。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 6.0s feet are planted; hands start moving forward by 7.0s.

steps.title: Raise both arms
steps.cue: Lift both arms forward to about shoulder height.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂一起向前上方抬至约肩高。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 8.0s hands rise; at 9.0s they reach upper chest to shoulder level.

steps.title: Bend and lower the arms
steps.cue: Bend the elbows and lower the hands while the knees soften.
steps.chineseCue: 双肘弯曲，手向下落，双膝随之微屈。
steps.boundaryEvidence: Elbows fold at 10.0s; by 11.0s the hands and body have lowered.

steps.title: Finish the downward press
steps.cue: Bring both hands down in front of the hips and settle.
steps.chineseCue: 双手继续落到胯前，完成这一小步。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 12.0-13.0s hands finish lowering in front of the hips.

steps.title: Round 1: turn and open
steps.cue: Turn the torso as one arm rises and the other opens low.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转动，一臂升高，另一臂向低处打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 13.3s hands are low; 14.3s one forearm is raised while the other opens sideways.

steps.title: Round 1: gather foot and arms
steps.cue: Draw the stepping foot in and round the arms in front of the body.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚收近，双臂在身前围合。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 15.8-16.3s the stepping knee is lifted; one arm is high and the other low in front.

steps.title: Round 1: reach with the heel
steps.cue: Extend the lifted leg and touch the heel ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的腿向前伸出，脚跟先落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 16.8-17.3s the lifted foot extends forward with its toes raised.

steps.title: Round 1: shift and separate
steps.cue: Move toward the front leg as the front arm opens and the rear hand lowers.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向前腿移动，前臂打开，后手下落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 17.8s forearms pass near the chest; 18.8s front arm extends and rear hand lowers.

steps.title: Round 1: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish the forward shift and let the two arms settle apart.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前的重心移动，双臂在分开的位置落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 19.3-19.8s show the completed forward stance with separated arms.

steps.title: Round 2: sit back and turn foot
steps.cue: Move back onto the rear leg and turn the front foot.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移到后腿，前脚随转体调整方向。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 20.8-21.3s front knee straightens and front toes lift as the body moves back.

steps.title: Round 2: gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Turn forward again and bring the rear foot in while the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 身体再次转向前方，后脚收近，双臂同时绕回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 22.3s body passes forward; 22.8-23.3s rear foot lifts and travels close to the standing leg.

steps.title: Round 2: lift and reach heel
steps.cue: Lift the stepping knee, then extend the heel ahead with the arms rounded.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步腿提起后向前伸跟，保持身前围合的双臂。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 24.3s knee is lifted; 24.8-25.3s the heel reaches ahead.

steps.title: Round 2: shift and separate
steps.cue: Move into the new front leg while opening the front arm and lowering the rear hand.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向新的前腿，前臂打开，后手下落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 25.8s foot is placed; 26.3-26.8s torso turns and arms separate.

steps.title: Round 2: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish opening the two arms and settle into the forward stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂继续分开，完成前腿弯曲的站姿。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 27.3-28.3s show the front arm extended and the rear hand lowered.

steps.title: Round 3: sit back and turn foot
steps.cue: Shift back and adjust the front foot before the next step.
steps.chineseCue: 重心后移，前脚调整方向，准备再迈步。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 29.3-30.3s front knee straightens and the front toes rise.

steps.title: Round 3: gather foot and arms
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot close as the hands circle into a rounded position.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚收近，双手同时绕回身前围合。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 31.3-32.3s rear foot lifts toward the standing leg while both arms gather.

steps.title: Round 3: reach with the heel
steps.cue: Extend the raised leg and place its heel ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的腿向前伸出，脚跟落地。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 32.8s knee is raised; 33.8-34.3s the leg extends with toes lifted.

steps.title: Round 3: shift and separate
steps.cue: Move toward the front leg and separate the hands to high and low positions.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向前腿，双手分向一高一低的位置。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 34.8s arms pass the chest; 35.3-35.8s front arm rises and rear hand lowers.

steps.title: Round 3: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish the forward stance with the arms apart.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前的站姿，双臂分开放稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 36.3-37.3s show the final parting stance; the rear heel begins to release only at the next transition.

steps.title: Bring the rear foot closer
steps.cue: Take the small gathering step while the hands start to lower.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚小步收近，双手开始下落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 37.7s rear heel releases; 38.7s the rear foot has moved close to the front leg.

steps.title: Shift back and raise the arms
steps.cue: Move onto the gathered rear leg and bring the forearms upward.
steps.chineseCue: 重心转到收近的后腿，双前臂向上绕起。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 39.7s weight transfers back; forearms rise in front of the chest by 40.7s.

steps.title: Lift the front foot and open
steps.cue: Lift the front knee while one arm rises high and the other opens low.
steps.chineseCue: 前膝提起，同时一臂向上、一臂向下打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 41.7s the front knee is raised with one hand above the head and the other forward-low.

steps.title: Set the front foot lightly
steps.cue: Place the front foot ahead and settle the high and low arm positions.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚向前落下，双臂一高一低落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 42.7-43.65s front foot extends and lowers while the arms stay separated.

steps.title: Round 1: lower and circle
steps.cue: Let the high arm circle down as the torso turns.
steps.chineseCue: 高举的手臂向下绕，身体随之转动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 43.7s one hand is high; 45.7s both arms have lowered and opened.

steps.title: Round 1: gather and raise
steps.cue: Bring the foot in as one arm circles up and the other crosses the front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚收近，一臂向上绕，另一臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 46.7s body turns toward the camera; 47.7s knee lifts with arms at high and middle levels.

steps.title: Round 1: reach the heel
steps.cue: Extend the stepping heel as the rear hand folds near the head.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚跟向前伸出，后手屈回头侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 48.7s forward heel extends while one hand is close to the head.

steps.title: Round 1: brush and push
steps.cue: Shift forward as the low hand passes the knee and the other hand pushes ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 身体前移，低手经过膝旁，另一手向前推。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 49.7s low hand crosses the knee area; 50.7s other hand is extended forward.

steps.title: Round 1: finish the push
steps.cue: Complete the front-leg bend and let the forward hand settle.
steps.chineseCue: 前腿弯曲到位，向前的手落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 51.7s shows the completed push with rear leg extended.

steps.title: Round 2: shift back and turn
steps.cue: Move back and adjust the front foot as the arms begin to circle.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移、前脚转向，双臂开始绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 52.7-53.7s body moves back, front toes lift and both arms begin circling.

steps.title: Round 2: gather the foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot close while the two arms pass in front.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚收近，双臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 54.7s rear heel lifts; 55.7s rear foot is close to the standing leg.

steps.title: Round 2: lift and reach
steps.cue: Raise the stepping knee, extend the heel, and fold the rear arm.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步腿提起再伸跟，后臂屈回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 56.7s knee lifts; 57.7s heel extends and rear hand is near the shoulder.

steps.title: Round 2: brush and push
steps.cue: Move forward as one hand brushes low and the other pushes.
steps.chineseCue: 身体前移，一手从低处绕过膝旁，另一手向前推。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 58.7s front foot plants and low hand passes across; 59.7s forward hand extends.

steps.title: Round 2: finish the push
steps.cue: Finish transferring forward with the arms apart.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前的重心移动，双臂分开放稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 60.7s shows the completed second forward push.

steps.title: Round 3: shift back and turn
steps.cue: Move back and turn the front foot before gathering.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移，前脚转向，准备收脚。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 61.7-62.7s front knee straightens and toes lift.

steps.title: Round 3: gather and circle
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot in while circling the arms upward.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚收近，双臂向上绕回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 63.7-64.7s rear foot gathers; one arm rises as body turns toward camera.

steps.title: Round 3: lift and reach
steps.cue: Lift the stepping knee and reach the heel out with the rear arm folded.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步膝提起后伸出脚跟，后臂屈回头侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 65.7s knee lifts; 66.7s heel extends and rear hand is near the head.

steps.title: Round 3: brush and push
steps.cue: Shift forward with the low hand passing the knee and the other hand pressing ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 身体前移，低手经过膝旁，另一手向前推出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 67.7s low hand passes knee; 68.7s forward hand extends.

steps.title: Round 3: finish the push
steps.cue: Complete the forward stance and settle the arms.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前站姿，双臂落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 69.7s the third push is completed before the rear foot releases.

steps.title: Bring the rear foot closer
steps.cue: Take a small gathering step as the arms soften forward.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚小步收近，双臂向前缓缓收拢。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 70.0s rear foot lifts; 71.0s it is gathered near the other foot.

steps.title: Shift back and lift the front foot
steps.cue: Move onto the rear leg while lifting the front knee and gathering the forearms.
steps.chineseCue: 重心转到后腿，前膝提起，双前臂收拢。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 72.0s body shifts back; 73.0s front knee lifts with forearms in front.

steps.title: Place the heel and finish the hands
steps.cue: Set the front heel ahead and bring one hand forward with the other near its elbow.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚跟向前落下，一手向前，另一手留在其肘旁。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 74.0-75.0s front heel extends and hands finish at upper and lower levels.

steps.title: Step 1: open the rear arm
steps.cue: Turn the torso and open the rear arm while keeping the other arm forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转动，后臂打开，另一臂留在前方。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 76.5s arms are open at opposing sides.

steps.title: Step 1: lift and fold
steps.cue: Lift the stepping foot as the rear hand folds toward the head.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚提起，后手同时屈向头侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 77.5s foot is lifted and rear hand is high beside the head.

steps.title: Step 1: place the foot behind
steps.cue: Reach the lifted foot backward while the folded hand starts forward.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的脚向后落，屈回的手开始向前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 78.5s rear foot reaches down behind the standing leg.

steps.title: Step 1: shift back and push
steps.cue: Shift onto the new rear leg while one hand pushes and the other draws in.
steps.chineseCue: 重心转到新的后腿，一手前推，另一手收回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 79.5-80.5s show the completed hand exchange and backward weight shift.

steps.title: Step 2: open the other arm
steps.cue: Turn and open the next rear arm.
steps.chineseCue: 转体，打开另一侧后臂。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 81.5s torso turns away and the rear arm opens low.

steps.title: Step 2: lift and fold
steps.cue: Lift the stepping leg as the rear hand comes toward the head.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步腿提起，后手向头侧屈回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 82.5s knee rises; 83.5s lifted foot is moving backward with the rear arm folded.

steps.title: Step 2: place the foot behind
steps.cue: Step backward and let the folded arm begin its forward path.
steps.chineseCue: 向后迈脚，屈回的手臂开始向前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 84.5s back foot is placed and both hands pass near the chest.

steps.title: Step 2: shift back and push
steps.cue: Move onto the rear leg and finish the hand exchange.
steps.chineseCue: 重心后移，完成一手前推、一手收回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 85.5-86.5s show front leg extending and hand finishing forward.

steps.title: Step 3: open the rear arm
steps.cue: Turn the torso and spread the rear arm away from the body.
steps.chineseCue: 转体，后臂向身体外侧打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 87.5s arms are spread with one low-rear and the other forward.

steps.title: Step 3: lift and fold
steps.cue: Lift the stepping foot and fold the rear hand near the head.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚提起，后手屈回头侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 88.5s front knee lifts with rear arm high; 89.5s foot has moved backward.

steps.title: Step 3: place the foot behind
steps.cue: Set the lifted foot back as the hands pass each other.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的脚向后落，双手在身前交替经过。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 90.5s back foot is planted and hands pass near chest height.

steps.title: Step 3: shift back and push
steps.cue: Move back and finish the forward hand position.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移，完成前手位置。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 91.5s hand push finishes; 92.5s body begins the next turn.

steps.title: Step 4: open the other arm
steps.cue: Turn and open the other rear arm for the final backward step.
steps.chineseCue: 转体，打开另一侧后臂，准备最后一次退步。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 93.5s both arms open during the turn.

steps.title: Step 4: lift and fold
steps.cue: Lift the stepping foot as the rear hand folds in beside the head.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚提起，后手屈向头侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 94.5s knee is raised with the rear hand beside the head.

steps.title: Step 4: place the foot behind
steps.cue: Place the foot behind as the folded hand moves forward.
steps.chineseCue: 脚向后落，屈回的手向前经过。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 95.5s foot reaches back; 96.5s arms have exchanged positions.

steps.title: Step 4: shift back and finish
steps.cue: Settle onto the rear leg and finish the forward hand.
steps.chineseCue: 重心后移到位，完成前手的位置。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 97.5-97.95s show the final backward stance and forward hand.

steps.title: Turn and open the arms
steps.cue: Turn toward the front as the two arms open.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转向正面，双臂打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 99.0s torso faces nearer the camera and both arms are spread.

steps.title: Gather foot and arms
steps.cue: Bring the foot close and round the hands in front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚收近，双手围到身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 100.0s stepping knee lifts with high and low rounded arms.

steps.title: Reach the heel ahead
steps.cue: Extend the lifted leg and set its heel ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的腿向前伸出，脚跟落地。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 101.0s stepping heel extends with toes up.

steps.title: Shift forward and open
steps.cue: Move into the front leg as the front forearm opens outward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向前腿，前臂向外打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 102.0-103.0s show weight moving forward and front arm opening.

steps.title: Bring the other hand forward
steps.cue: Circle the rear hand forward toward the raised forearm.
steps.chineseCue: 后手向前绕到抬起的前臂附近。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 104.0s rear arm begins to rise; 105.0s both hands are near the forward side.

steps.title: Turn and lower both hands
steps.cue: Turn the torso and let both forearms travel downward together.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转动，双前臂一起向下带。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 105.0s hands are high-forward; 106.0s they have lowered with torso turning.

steps.title: Shift back and sweep across
steps.cue: Move back as both arms sweep across the front of the body.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移，双臂经过身前向另一侧带。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 107.0s hands are low and body faces camera; 108.0s one arm has swept upward across.

steps.title: Fold the forearms to the chest
steps.cue: Bring the two forearms close together in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 双前臂收近，放到胸前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 109.0s arms gather; 110.0s forearms are folded close to chest.

steps.title: Shift forward with the press
steps.cue: Move toward the front leg as both forearms press forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向前腿，双前臂一起向前送。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 111.0-112.0s body moves forward and both arms extend.

steps.title: Finish the forward press
steps.cue: Complete the forward transfer with both arms in front.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前移重心，双臂留在前方。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 112.0-113.0s show the completed press before hands separate.

steps.title: Separate and draw the hands back
steps.cue: Separate both hands and bring them back as the body shifts rearward.
steps.chineseCue: 双手分开收回，身体随之后移。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 114.0s hands separate; 115.0s front toes lift and hands draw toward chest.

steps.title: Lower and bring the hands forward
steps.cue: Let the hands lower, then start them forward as the body returns.
steps.chineseCue: 双手先下落，再随身体开始前移。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 116.0s hands are low; 117.0s they rise forward as weight returns.

steps.title: Finish the two-hand push
steps.cue: Finish moving forward with both hands extended.
steps.chineseCue: 身体前移到位，双手向前伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 118.0-118.95s show the completed two-hand push.

steps.title: Shift back and turn
steps.cue: Move back and turn across the front as the arms open.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移并转过正面，双臂打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 120.0s body has shifted back and begins turning toward camera.

steps.title: Continue the turn and gather
steps.cue: Turn to the other side and gather the arms in front.
steps.chineseCue: 身体继续转向另一侧，双臂在身前围合。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 121.0s arms are open; 122.0s foot gathers with torso turned to the other side.

steps.title: Lift the stepping knee
steps.cue: Bring the stepping foot in and lift the knee with arms rounded.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚收近并提起膝，双臂保持围合。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 123.0s lifted knee and rounded arms are visible.

steps.title: Reach the heel ahead
steps.cue: Extend the lifted heel toward the new direction.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的脚跟向新的方向伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 124.0s leg extends with heel leading.

steps.title: Shift forward and open
steps.cue: Move onto the new front leg and open the front forearm.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向新的前腿，前臂向外打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 125.0s forearms pass near chest; 126.0s front arm opens and rear hand lowers.

steps.title: Bring both hands forward
steps.cue: Circle the rear hand forward so both forearms rise in front.
steps.chineseCue: 后手绕到前方，双前臂在身前抬起。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 127.0s rear hand is low; 128.0-129.0s both hands move high-forward.

steps.title: Turn and lower the forearms
steps.cue: Turn the torso as the two forearms move downward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转动，双前臂向下带。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 129.0s hands are high; 130.0s hands lower as torso turns toward camera.

steps.title: Shift back and sweep across
steps.cue: Move back and sweep the arms across the front to the other side.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移，双臂经过身前带向另一侧。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 131.0s hands are low-center; 132.0s arm has swept upward across.

steps.title: Fold the forearms inward
steps.cue: Bring both forearms close together in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 双前臂收拢到胸前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 133.0s hands gather; 134.0s both forearms are folded close to chest.

steps.title: Shift forward with the press
steps.cue: Move into the front leg while pressing the forearms forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向前腿，双前臂向前送。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 135.0-136.0s body and both arms move forward together.

steps.title: Finish the forward press
steps.cue: Finish the front-leg bend and settle both forearms in front.
steps.chineseCue: 前腿弯曲到位，双前臂在身前落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 136.0-137.0s show the completed press before the hands separate.

steps.title: Separate and draw back
steps.cue: Separate the hands and shift back while drawing the arms in.
steps.chineseCue: 双手分开收回，身体后移。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 138.0s hands separate; 139.0s body has shifted back and front toes lift.

steps.title: Lower hands and begin returning
steps.cue: Lower the hands and start the body forward again.
steps.chineseCue: 双手下落，身体开始再次向前移动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 140.0s hands are at waist level; 141.0s hands and body begin forward together.

steps.title: Finish the two-hand push
steps.cue: Complete the forward shift with both hands extended.
steps.chineseCue: 完成前移，双手向前伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 142.0-142.95s show the finished forward push.

steps.title: Shift back and turn front
steps.cue: Move back and turn toward the front as one hand lowers.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移转向正面，一手下落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 144.0s torso turns toward camera as one arm remains raised and one lowers.

steps.title: Sweep the arms across
steps.cue: Turn across the front while the arms pass across the body.
steps.chineseCue: 身体继续转动，双臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 145.0s arms begin crossing; 146.0s torso has turned to the other side.

steps.title: Gather foot and circle the arms
steps.cue: Bring the foot close while one arm rises and the other circles low.
steps.chineseCue: 脚收近，一臂向上，另一臂向低处绕。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 147.0s feet draw close; 148.0s both arms pass in front.

steps.title: Lift the knee and extend one arm
steps.cue: Lift the stepping knee while the opposite arm extends to the side.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步膝提起，另一侧手臂向侧面伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 149.0s stepping knee is raised with one arm extended sideways.

steps.title: Reach the heel and turn
steps.cue: Extend the lifted heel and turn the other arm toward the new front.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的脚跟伸出，另一臂随转体朝向新的前方。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 150.0s heel extends while front hand remains near face height.

steps.title: Open into the wide stance
steps.cue: Move toward the front leg and open the arms to either side.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向前腿，双臂向两侧展开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 151.0-151.95s show the open final stance.

steps.title: Begin the cloud turn
steps.cue: Turn across the front, keeping one arm high as the other lowers.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转过正面，一臂保持高位，另一臂下绕。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 152.0s arms are spread; 154.0s body faces nearer the front and one arm lowers.

steps.title: Shift across and circle
steps.cue: Move across the open stance while the arms trade high and low paths.
steps.chineseCue: 身体在开立站姿间横移，双臂交换一高一低的路径。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 155.0s body turns to the other side and arms have traded height.

steps.title: Bring the trailing foot in
steps.cue: Draw the trailing foot close while continuing the arm circles.
steps.chineseCue: 后随的脚收近，双臂继续绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 156.0s trailing foot moves inward; 157.0s feet are close.

steps.title: Finish the circle with feet close
steps.cue: Keep the feet close as the upper arm crosses the front.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚收近，较高的手臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 157.0-158.0s feet stay close as hands complete the circle.

steps.title: Step out with the next circle
steps.cue: Lift the stepping foot and place it sideways while the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂绕动时，迈步脚提起并向侧面落下。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 159.0s knee lifts; 160.0s foot extends sideways.

steps.title: Shift across the open stance
steps.cue: Move across the open feet and exchange the high and low arms.
steps.chineseCue: 身体在打开的双脚间横移，双臂交换高低。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 161.0s feet are wide; 162.0s weight travels across and trailing foot starts moving in.

steps.title: Bring the trailing foot in
steps.cue: Bring the following foot close while the arms keep circling.
steps.chineseCue: 后随的脚收近，双臂继续绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 162.0-163.0s trailing foot travels toward the other foot.

steps.title: Finish the circle with feet close
steps.cue: Keep the narrowed stance as one arm passes in front.
steps.chineseCue: 保持收近的站距，一臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 164.0s feet are close with hands passing in front.

steps.title: Take the next sideways step
steps.cue: Lift and place the stepping foot sideways as the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂绕动时，迈步脚再次提起并向侧面落下。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 165.0s stepping knee lifts; 166.0s foot reaches out sideways.

steps.title: Shift across and exchange arms
steps.cue: Move across the wide stance while the two arms exchange height.
steps.chineseCue: 身体在开立的双脚间横移，双臂交换高低。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 167.0s stance is wide and arms pass at opposing heights.

steps.title: Gather the following foot
steps.cue: Draw the following foot close with the arm circle continuing.
steps.chineseCue: 后随的脚收近，双臂继续完成这一圈。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 168.0s trailing foot lifts inward; 169.0s feet are close.

steps.title: Finish the final cloud circle
steps.cue: Keep the feet close and finish the arms across the front.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚收近，双臂完成经过身前的绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 169.0-170.25s feet remain close while arms finish crossing the front.

steps.title: Gather the arms in front
steps.cue: Circle both arms in front while keeping the feet close.
steps.chineseCue: 保持脚收近，双臂绕到身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 170.3-171.3s feet remain close and hands gather in front.

steps.title: Lift the knee and extend the arm
steps.cue: Raise the stepping knee as one arm extends sideways.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步膝提起，同时一臂向侧面伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 172.3s knee lifts with one arm extended to the side.

steps.title: Place the heel and open
steps.cue: Reach the heel out and open the other arm toward the front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚跟伸出落地，另一臂向新的前方打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 173.3s heel reaches out; 174.3s body transfers into the front leg.

steps.title: Finish the wide stance
steps.cue: Complete the forward shift with both arms spread.
steps.chineseCue: 身体前移到位，双臂展开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 175.3s open final stance; 175.95s rear foot begins the next gathering transition.

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot closer as the two arms open upward.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚收近，双臂同时向上打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 176.0s rear foot lifts; 177.0s it gathers while both arms open high.

steps.title: Shift back and fold the arms
steps.cue: Move onto the rear leg as one hand folds toward the head and the other draws in.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向后腿，一手屈向头侧，另一手收回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 178.0s rear hand is beside the head; 179.0s front foot is lifted and hands gather.

steps.title: Set the front foot and press
steps.cue: Place the front foot ahead while one hand extends forward.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚向前落下，同时一手向前伸出。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 180.0-180.95s front foot is down and forward hand extends.

steps.title: Gather the stepping knee
steps.cue: Bring the stepping foot in as both hands begin to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 随着双手开始上提，把准备迈出的脚收拢。

steps.title: Place the forward heel
steps.cue: Reach the foot forward while both arms continue their upward arc.
steps.chineseCue: 脚向前伸出，同时双臂继续向上画弧。

steps.title: Settle and lower the arms
steps.cue: Settle into the step as the hands sweep down in front.
steps.chineseCue: 落稳这一步，双手随身体在身前向下落。

steps.title: Raise the right knee
steps.cue: Draw the right foot up into a bent-knee balance.
steps.chineseCue: 把右脚收起，屈膝上提。

steps.title: Bring the forearms up
steps.cue: Keep the knee gathered while the forearms rise in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖保持收拢，双前臂向胸前提起。

steps.title: Extend the right heel
steps.cue: Extend the right heel while opening the arms; use a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 右脚跟向外伸出，双臂同时展开；高度以舒服为准。

steps.title: Settle the open shape
steps.cue: Follow the open arm shape with the leg extended at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂保持展开，伸出的腿停在自己舒服的高度。

steps.title: Fold the right knee back
steps.cue: Bend the raised knee again as the arms move forward.
steps.chineseCue: 抬着的腿再次屈膝收回，双臂同时转向前方。

steps.title: Gather both hands
steps.cue: Keep the knee raised while drawing both hands slightly inward.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖仍抬着，双手稍稍向内收拢。

steps.title: Lower the right heel
steps.cue: Lower the raised leg forward while the hands descend.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的腿向前放下，双手同时下落。

steps.title: Plant the foot and open
steps.cue: Plant the stepping foot and open both arms as the body settles forward.
steps.chineseCue: 迈出的脚落稳，身体向前落，双臂同时展开。

steps.title: Arc both forearms forward
steps.cue: Bring both bent arms upward and inward together.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂同时屈肘，向上、向前合拢。

steps.title: Settle the paired-arm shape
steps.cue: Let the forward stance and paired arms finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 前方站姿和双臂一起停稳。

steps.title: Begin the turn
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso away as the arms arc upward.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向另一面，双臂同时向上画弧。

steps.title: Finish turning and lower
steps.cue: Continue the turn while lowering the hands toward the waist.
steps.chineseCue: 继续转身，双手同时落向腰部附近。

steps.title: Raise the left knee
steps.cue: Gather the left leg into a bent-knee balance.
steps.chineseCue: 收拢左腿，屈膝上提。

steps.title: Raise the forearms
steps.cue: Keep the knee gathered as both forearms rise in front.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖保持收拢，双前臂在身前上提。

steps.title: Extend the left heel
steps.cue: Open the arms as the left heel extends; use a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 左脚跟向外伸出，双臂同时展开；高度以舒服为准。

steps.title: Settle the left-leg extension
steps.cue: Follow the open shape without needing the instructor's kick height.
steps.chineseCue: 停稳展开姿态，不必追求示范中的踢腿高度。

steps.title: Fold the left knee back
steps.cue: Bend the raised left leg while keeping the arms open.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的左腿屈膝收回，双臂仍展开。

steps.title: Gather the arms
steps.cue: Bring the arms toward one side while keeping the knee gathered.
steps.chineseCue: 抬膝保持收拢，双臂向一侧转过来。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Reach the left foot sideways
steps.cue: Lower and reach the left foot out to the side.
steps.chineseCue: 左脚向侧方放下、伸开。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Lower into the wide stance
steps.cue: Bend the supporting leg as one hand sweeps downward; choose your own depth.
steps.chineseCue: 支撑腿弯曲，一只手同时向下扫；下沉深度以自己能做为准。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Move across the wide stance
steps.cue: Move the torso toward the extended-leg side as the low arm travels forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向伸腿的一侧移动，低处的手臂同时向前走。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Rise into the forward stance
steps.cue: Rise gradually as the leading arm reaches forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体逐渐升起，前方手臂随之向前伸。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Draw the rear foot inward while both hands sweep down.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双手同时向下画弧。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Raise the right knee and arm
steps.cue: Lift the right knee while one forearm rises in front.
steps.chineseCue: 右膝上提，同时一侧前臂在身前升起。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Settle the one-leg shape
steps.cue: Pause in the gathered-knee shape at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 在自己舒服的抬膝高度停稳。
steps.parentFormTitle: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Lower the raised foot
steps.cue: Lower the raised foot as the torso turns toward the camera.
steps.chineseCue: 放下抬起的脚，身体同时向正面转。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Turn under the raised arm
steps.cue: Continue turning while the upper arm follows an overhead arc.
steps.chineseCue: 上方手臂画弧，身体继续转向。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Reach the right foot sideways
steps.cue: Send the right foot sideways as the arms gather to the new side.
steps.chineseCue: 右脚向侧方伸出，双臂同时向新的一侧收拢。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Lower into the other wide stance
steps.cue: Bend the supporting leg and let the lower hand descend; use your own depth.
steps.chineseCue: 支撑腿弯曲，低处的手臂下降；下沉深度以自己能做为准。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Sweep the low arm across
steps.cue: Follow the low arm across the extended leg as the torso turns.
steps.chineseCue: 随着身体转动，低处手臂沿伸腿方向横扫。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Move across and begin rising
steps.cue: Move toward the extended-leg side and begin to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向伸腿一侧横移，并开始升起。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Reach into the forward stance
steps.cue: Continue rising while the leading arm extends ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 继续起身，前方手臂同时伸出。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward as both hands lower.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双手同时下落。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Raise the left knee and arm
steps.cue: Lift the left knee while one forearm rises in front.
steps.chineseCue: 左膝上提，一侧前臂同时在身前升起。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Settle the second one-leg shape
steps.cue: Pause with the knee gathered at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 抬膝保持收拢，在舒服的高度停稳。
steps.parentFormTitle: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Place the raised foot forward
steps.cue: Lower the raised foot into the next step as the hands separate.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的脚向前落下，双手同时分开。

steps.title: Settle and gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Settle into the step and draw the rear foot inward.
steps.chineseCue: 先随着这一步落稳，后脚继续向身体收拢。

steps.title: Turn and gather the arms
steps.cue: Turn toward the first diagonal while the hands circle inward.
steps.chineseCue: 转向第一个斜前方，双手同时向内画弧。

steps.title: Step onto the first diagonal
steps.cue: Place the next foot diagonally as the upper arm begins to lift.
steps.chineseCue: 向第一个斜前方落脚，上方手臂同时开始抬起。

steps.title: Lift one arm and reach
steps.cue: Settle forward as one arm curves overhead and the other reaches ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向前落，一臂向头上画弧，另一臂同时向前伸。

steps.title: Settle the first diagonal shape
steps.cue: Let the overhead arm and forward arm finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 上方手臂和前方手臂一起停稳。

steps.title: Turn toward the other side
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso as both arms circle back in front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向，双臂同时画弧回到身前。

steps.title: Gather the next stepping foot
steps.cue: Draw the next stepping foot inward while the hands lower and gather.
steps.chineseCue: 准备迈出的脚向身体收拢，双手同时下落、收拢。

steps.title: Step onto the second diagonal
steps.cue: Reach the heel out toward the next diagonal while the arms begin to open.
steps.chineseCue: 脚跟向另一个斜前方伸出，双臂同时开始展开。

steps.title: Lift the other overhead arm
steps.cue: Settle into the new step while the other arm arcs above the head.
steps.chineseCue: 身体落入新的一步，另一侧手臂同时向头上画弧。

steps.title: Finish the forward reach
steps.cue: Extend the forward arm and settle the second diagonal stance.
steps.chineseCue: 前方手臂伸出，第二个斜向站姿一起落稳。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward as the arms begin to lower.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双臂同时开始下落。

steps.title: Shift back and turn
steps.cue: Move back over the rear leg while turning the torso and gathering the arms.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向后腿一侧移动，躯干转动，双臂收拢。

steps.title: Gather the front knee
steps.cue: Draw the front foot up while one hand comes near the shoulder.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚收起，一只手同时收至肩部附近。

steps.title: Place the foot and reach down
steps.cue: Place the foot lightly forward as the torso inclines and the hand descends.
steps.chineseCue: 脚向前轻轻放下，身体同时前倾，手向下伸。

steps.title: Settle the low reach
steps.cue: Finish the downward reach at a comfortable depth.
steps.chineseCue: 在自己舒服的深度完成向下伸展。

steps.title: Rise and lift the arms
steps.cue: Begin rising from the low reach as both arms lift in front.
steps.chineseCue: 从低处开始起身，双臂同时在身前提起。

steps.title: Step forward and separate
steps.cue: Reach the front heel forward while one arm rises and the other opens ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚跟向前伸出，一臂向上、另一臂向前同时展开。

steps.title: Settle the high-and-forward shape
steps.cue: Settle into the step with one arm above and the other reaching forward.
steps.chineseCue: 随着脚步落稳，一臂在上，另一臂向前。

steps.title: Turn to the opposite direction
steps.cue: Pivot the feet and torso as the arms open and lower.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向，双臂同时展开并下落。

steps.title: Gather the stepping knee
steps.cue: Bring the next stepping foot up while one forearm circles across the body.
steps.chineseCue: 准备迈出的脚收起，一侧前臂同时绕过身前。

steps.title: Reach the heel forward
steps.cue: Reach the heel forward while the bent forearm turns upward.
steps.chineseCue: 脚跟向前伸出，屈着的前臂同时向上转。

steps.title: Plant the foot and sweep ahead
steps.cue: Set the foot down and move forward as the forearm travels ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 脚落下，身体随之前移，前臂同时向前走。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot and open
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward while both arms open apart.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双臂同时向两侧展开。

steps.title: Raise the next knee
steps.cue: Bring the next knee up as the arms continue to exchange positions.
steps.chineseCue: 下一侧膝盖上提，双臂同时继续交换前后位置。

steps.title: Reach the next heel forward
steps.cue: Extend the gathered foot forward while the front hand reaches ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 收起的脚向前伸出，前方手臂同时向前走。

steps.title: Settle behind the forward hand
steps.cue: Plant the foot and settle forward with the open hand in front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚落稳，身体向前落，前方手臂伸出。

steps.title: Extend the punching arm
steps.cue: Bring the other forearm forward as the body moves into the stance.
steps.chineseCue: 另一侧前臂向前伸出，身体同时进入前方站姿。

steps.title: Settle the forward extension
steps.cue: Let the extended arm and stance finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 伸出的手臂与站姿一起停稳。

steps.title: Bring the hands together ahead
steps.cue: Bring the lower hand toward the extended forearm in front.
steps.chineseCue: 下方的手向前方伸出的前臂靠拢。

steps.title: Shift back and bend the elbows
steps.cue: Move the torso back while both elbows bend.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向后移动，双肘同时弯曲。

steps.title: Lower the gathered hands
steps.cue: Continue drawing the hands down toward the waist.
steps.chineseCue: 双手继续向下收至腰部附近。

steps.title: Move forward and raise the hands
steps.cue: Move forward again as both hands rise in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 身体再次向前移动，双手同时提至胸前。

steps.title: Extend both arms forward
steps.cue: Extend both arms and settle into the forward stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂向前伸出，前方站姿同时落稳。

steps.title: Turn toward the camera
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso toward the camera as one arm arcs across the front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体转向正面，一臂同时在身前画弧。

steps.title: Open both arms wide
steps.cue: Open the arms to either side while settling into the wide stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂向两侧展开，身体同时落入较宽的站姿。

steps.title: Lower both arms
steps.cue: Let both arms sweep outward and down together.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂一起向外、向下画弧。

steps.title: Cross the forearms low
steps.cue: Bring the forearms inward and across as the torso begins to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 双前臂向内交叉，身体同时开始升起。

steps.title: Gather the foot and lift the cross
steps.cue: Bring the wide foot inward while the crossed forearms rise toward the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 外侧脚向内收，交叉的双前臂同时提向胸前。

steps.title: Settle the crossed-arm stance
steps.cue: Settle both feet and hold the crossed forearms in front.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚落稳，交叉的双前臂停在身前。

steps.title: Uncross the forearms
steps.cue: Uncross both forearms and separate the hands in front.
steps.chineseCue: 把交叉的双前臂解开，双手在身前分开。

steps.title: Reach both hands forward
steps.cue: Let both hands reach gently forward together.
steps.chineseCue: 双手一起轻轻向前展开。

steps.title: Lower the hands and rise
steps.cue: Lower both hands while the knees straighten gradually.
steps.chineseCue: 双手下落，双膝同时逐渐伸展。

steps.title: Settle the arms at the sides
steps.cue: Let both arms finish lowering beside the body.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂继续落下，停在身体两侧。

steps.title: Bring the left foot in
steps.cue: Bring the left foot inward to close the stance.
steps.chineseCue: 把左脚向内收拢，站姿合起。

steps.title: Finish standing
steps.cue: Stand with the feet gathered and the arms resting at the sides.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚并拢，双臂自然落在身侧，停稳。
